model.name: esports-player-projections-v1
model.note: Each projection is that player's own rate from his earlier games, newest weighted most and pulled toward the field when he has few: CS2 kills and headshots per round over maps 1 and 2 (each map 13 to about 30 rounds), Dota 2 and League of Legends per game. The displayed game is never part of its own projection, and a player with no earlier game in the feed gets none. The ranges are calibrated on the same players' earlier games so 8 in 10 results land inside, and the plain average is shown under each projection. No match winner and no posted line were used.
